subject: WooCommerce
purpose: Source facts for per-wallet social media content (image + caption). Pair one fact with each wallet co-marketing card.
note: User-provided marketing stats. Verify / cite a source before publishing — some figures are approximate or vary by source (e.g. #4 'one in four' vs the '30%' label).

facts.title: Largest market share
facts.text: WooCommerce holds 38.76% of the ecommerce platform market, beating Shopify (23.43%) and Wix (11.87%).

facts.title: Most installations
facts.text: 8+ million active installs on WordPress.org — the highest of any ecommerce plugin.

facts.title: Dominates WordPress ecommerce
facts.text: 93.7% of WordPress-based ecommerce sites use WooCommerce.

facts.title: Powers a huge share of stores
facts.text: Approximately 1 in every 4 online stores globally runs on WooCommerce.

facts.title: $20B+ annual GMV
facts.text: WooCommerce stores process over $20 billion in transactions every year since 2020.

facts.title: #1 by store count
facts.text: It's the #1 ecommerce platform ahead of Shopify, Magento, and BigCommerce when measured by number of stores.

facts.title: Most downloaded
facts.text: WooCommerce has been downloaded 200M+ times lifetime.

facts.title: Fastest-growing open source
facts.text: It's the fastest-growing open-source ecommerce platform on Earth.

facts.title: Massive ecosystem
facts.text: 55,000+ WordPress plugins work with WooCommerce, and stores use 25–35 active plugins on average.

facts.title: 1,100+ official extensions
facts.text: The WooCommerce marketplace lists 1,100+ official extensions.

facts.title: 3,700+ themes
facts.text: Over 3,700 WooCommerce-compatible themes exist (ThemeForest + WordPress.org).

facts.title: Global reach
facts.text: Used in 200+ countries with multilingual support in 93 languages.

facts.title: SMB dominance
facts.text: 70%+ of WooCommerce stores are Small to Medium Businesses (SMBs).

facts.title: High merchant retention
facts.text: WooCommerce retains ~82% year-over-year merchant continuity — merchants rarely switch away.

facts.title: Solo entrepreneur favorite
facts.text: 62% of WooCommerce stores are run by solo entrepreneurs or micro-teams.

facts.title: Top 1% earn $1M+/year
facts.text: The top 1% of WooCommerce stores earn $1M+ annually.

facts.title: Surpassed Shopify & Wix
facts.text: WooCommerce has surpassed Shopify and Wix in market share (38.76% vs. 23.43% vs. 11.87%).

facts.title: 30% of the top 1M sites
facts.text: WooCommerce accounts for ~30% of the top 1M ecommerce sites worldwide.

facts.title: 7% of global online sales
facts.text: The platform accounts for approximately 7% of all global online sales.

facts.title: Open-source freedom
facts.text: Unlike Shopify's hosted model, WooCommerce is completely free and open-source — full control over customization, data, and hosting.
